risks.R-01: Legacy seeded SQLite DB lacks alembic_version; alembic upgrade head fails 'table departments already exists'. M4 evidence covers empty/isolated databases only; remediating the legacy seeded DB remains an operator data-migration task.
risks.R-02: Windows Application Control blocks SQLAlchemy 2.1.x compiled DLLs; repository currently runs SQLAlchemy 2.0.55 (pure-python wheel, within sqlalchemy>=2.0).
risks.R-03: GPU compositor previously composited CSS filter/backdrop-filter layers above portaled dialog content; dialogs now use a fully transparent backdrop (operator decision).
risks.R-04: Headless UI tests run with --disable-gpu; GPU-only regressions cannot be detected by automation.
risks.R-05: RESOLVED 2026-11-05 (was: Docker daemon availability unknown). Docker is installed; systemd daemon runs at /var/run/docker.sock. The CLI's desktop-linux context referenced an absent Docker Desktop socket and is bypassed with DOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock. M10 executed on this daemon.
risks.R-06: Single-commit history with large uncommitted operator changes; preserve, do not stage or commit without authorization.
risks.R-07: CRLF/LF autocrlf conversion warnings; avoid normalizing untouched files.
risks.R-08: Phase 2 requires PostgreSQL-backed evidence for row locks, leases, outbox claims, and scheduler uniqueness; SQLite cannot certify those concurrency claims. M12/M13 must provision a PostgreSQL test service.
risks.R-09: No physical or virtual device lab is assumed. Provisioning and drift tests must use adapter fakes and recorded fixtures; real-device validation is a separate operator-approved gate.
risks.R-10: Device credentials and raw configurations are sensitive. Workers must not persist secrets; snapshots must be redacted before storage and raw config retention, if enabled, must be encrypted and time-bounded.
